# Karthik Raja Anandan

> Founding ML Engineer (Data Scientist) at Elas (Pleasanton, CA), building and validating agentic AI systems — test-automation frameworks, multi-agent routing, and developer tooling across 10+ services. M.S. in Artificial Intelligence (Natural Language Processing), UC Santa Cruz (2025, GPA 3.9/4.0). Open-source contributor to Google Tunix, LangChain, and Ivy; co-author of the SemEval-2025 Task 3 Best System Paper (hallucination detection); demoed GPU kernels at NVIDIA GTC 2026.

Personal portfolio and blog of Karthik Raja Anandan, Founding ML Engineer (Data Scientist) at Elas based in Pleasanton, CA. Contact: kanandan@ucsc.edu. GitHub: https://github.com/kitrakrev. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kitrakrev. Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=fK1cR-8AAAAJ&hl=en.

## Experience

- Data Scientist — Founding ML Engineer @ Elas (Jan 2026 - Present): Founding ML engineer (title: Data Scientist) building and validating production agentic AI systems — post-training, evals, multi-agent routing, and developer tooling across 10+ services.
- Data Analysis & Machine Learning Intern @ Elas (Jun 2025 - Sep 2025): Full-time summer internship on Elas's AI platform, reporting to the data science lead.
- AI Research Engineer @ Samsung Research Capstone (Sep 2025 - Dec 2025): Built an autonomous GUI agent and automated test harnesses for long-horizon web task validation and quantized model inference.
- Software Developer (C09) @ Citi Corp (Jul 2023 - Sep 2024): Built event-driven microservices processing millions of financial events daily, with integration tests, CI/CD, and developer tooling.
- NLP Engineering Intern @ MultiOn (AI agents startup) (Jun 2023 - Aug 2023): Shipped open-source integrations for agentic browser automation; improved agent accuracy by 40%.
